title.b: I Will Offer You My Life

meta.author:
讚美之泉
詞、曲：曾祥怡

lines.a: 獻上生命 給最愛的耶穌
lines.b: I surrender all my life to Jesus

lines.a: 完全順服 完全降服
lines.b: Give my everything for Your glory

lines.a: 因祢恩典 使我得以事奉祢
lines.b: By Your grace alone, I can serve You with my all
It's my calling, no holding back

lines.a: 我的生命獻給祢 背起十架跟隨祢
lines.b: I will offer You my life, and with everything I have

lines.a: 願祢的榮耀 彰顯在我生命
lines.b: Let Your glory come. Your name be lifted high

lines.a: 我的心不要忘記 祢如何為我捨命
lines.b: Oh, my heart will not forget what You did upon the cross

lines.a: 耶穌我愛祢 喜樂地跟隨祢
lines.b: Jesus, I love You, with joy, I follow You
Let me see, see Your dreams and visions
Bringing down Your kingdom as in heaven

lines.a: 賜給我奔跑不倦的力量
lines.b: Let me run, run and not be weary
Like an eagle, soaring with You

lines.a: 耶穌我愛祢 喜樂地跟隨祢
lines.b: Jesus, I love You, with joy, I follow You

lines.a: 獻上生命 給最愛的耶穌
lines.b: I surrender all my life to Jesus
I love You, I love You
